title: Paste something that used to be a table
variant: Text in, four formats out, and it says which guess it made
prompt: I keep copying tables out of PDFs and getting a mess of spaces. Give me something that turns that back into a table.
note: The text-reshaping shape, and the example that opens on the hard case on purpose: its heading contains a space, so anything splitting on whitespace turns four columns into five and ruins the header row. The rule it uses instead -- pick the separator whose column count varies least -- is one a reader can check in a sentence, which is why it is printed above the result. Rows that do not fit are marked rather than padded, because a padded row hides the one you needed to see, and nothing is type-coerced, since guessing types is where importers eat leading zeros. The privacy line is load-bearing here rather than decorative: the text people most need to reshape is the text they least want to paste into a website.
